name: url_scheme
description: Supply http versus https scheme from explicit secure/unsecured website specification; matched controls extract the host from the same specification.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(96):
 secure=bool(i%2); host=random.choice(['cedar','maple','birch','willow','pine','oak'])+random.choice(['.com','.org','.net','.edu'])
 protocol='https' if secure else 'http'; mode='secure HTTPS' if secure else 'unencrypted HTTP'
 p=f'Website: {host}. Connection type: {mode}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the lowercase URL scheme, without ://. Answer:', 'answer':' '+protocol})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the website hostname. Answer:', 'answer':' '+host})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
